node.label: Films, books & arts
node.summary: Films, books, authors and artists in the news.

facts.text: A **National Book Trust** survey at the **New Delhi World Book Fair 2026** found Gen Z favours global fiction (*The Silent Patient*, *Yellowface*), Korean fiction like **Han Kang**'s *The Vegetarian*, and Kabir and Ambedkar in Hindi. NBT is under the **Education Ministry**.

facts.text: Hundreds joined a **'Walk for Books'** (Boiyer Jonno Hatun) on **College Street** (Boipara), Kolkata, after at least **292** Left book stalls were attacked during **Durga Puja**. West Bengal CM: **Suvendu Adhikari**.

facts.text: Namit Malhotra's ***Ramayana***, billed as the most expensive Indian film, stars **Ranbir Kapoor** as Rama and **Yash** as Ravana and releases on **5 Nov**.

facts.text: Book ***The Relentless Sprinter*** (Shanker Basu, ex-Indian cricket team strength coach) traces sprinter **Nithin's** national **200m record of 20.66 seconds**.

facts.text: Tamil film ***Dorothy*** (dir. **Karthik Subbaraj**, released 25 Sept) uses the rooster motif of **Bahuchara Mata**, a goddess linked with transgender communities whose mount is a **rooster**.
